summary: Retest of CP4.35 fix for P1 double-inherit locked_by attribution regression. Ran full P1 CP4.35 suite (11 tests) + P0 CP4.34 suite (9 tests) via pytest. All 20 tests PASSED including the previously failing test_managed_and_self_dedup_managed_wins. Fix confirmed: channel-scoped attribution fields (default_lock_managed_set_by_user_id + default_self_lock_set_by_user_id) work correctly; create_task inherit correctly reads managed field with legacy fallback; no regressions in P0 suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CP4.35 double-inherit fix verified. Previously failing test now passes; P0 CP4.34 suite still green. No further backend action required for this iteration.
rca of the issue: Previous iter_65 regression: patch_user_lock_flags wrote default_lock_set_by_user_id in both channels, so assignee self-patch overwrote admin's managed attribution. Fix introduced channel-scoped fields (default_lock_managed_set_by_user_id vs default_self_lock_set_by_user_id) and updated create_task inherit to read the managed field with legacy fallback. Verified via test_managed_and_self_dedup_managed_wins: admin managed -> ahmet self -> task.locked_by == admin.id.
